text: {"thesis":"Macro-catalyst day with no provided signals means there is no directional edge to underwrite; size as event-risk exposure rather than conviction. With a 1.5-ATR stop, that implies notional exposure of roughly 12-24% of capital (0.25-0.5% / 2.09%), or less if liquidity/volatility worsens.
